prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Pleasanton California?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for everyone — the right attorney depends on the type and severity of your case, whether you want a trial lawyer, and how you prefer to work with the lawyer. I can help you find a top lawyer in Pleasanton, but here are practical steps and criteria to pick the best one for your situation.

How to find strong candidates
- Use reputable directories: Avvo, Martindale-Hubbell, Super Lawyers, and Google/Yelp reviews.  
- Get local referrals: ask friends, family, or other lawyers.  
- Contact the Alameda County Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service for local, prescreened attorneys.  
- Verify credentials on the State Bar of California website (license status, any discipline).

Key criteria to evaluate
- Relevant experience: number of years and percentage of practice in personal injury; experience with your type of injury (auto, slip-and-fall, medical malpractice, wrongful death, catastrophic injuries).  
- Track record: settlements and verdicts for similar cases (ask for examples, not just marketing claims).  
- Trial experience: many cases settle, but a lawyer comfortable in court is a stronger negotiator.  
- Resources: a firm with investigators, medical experts and the capacity to handle complex cases.  
- Communication style: how often they’ll update you, who will handle day-to-day work (partner vs. associate).  
- Fees and costs: contingency fee percentage, who advances litigation costs, how costs are deducted from recovery.  
- Client reviews and references.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? What were the results?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day? Will you or another attorney?  
- What is your contingency fee and what additional costs should I expect?  
- Do you have trial experience? Have you gone to verdict in similar cases?  
- How long do you expect this case to take?  
- Can you provide references from past clients?

What to check online
- State Bar lookup for license and discipline history.  
- Recent client reviews and any news about large settlements/verdicts.  
- Peer recognitions (Super Lawyers, AV Preeminent/Martindale ratings).

If you want, I can:
- Help draft an email or phone script for initial consultations.  
- Search for top-rated personal injury lawyers in Pleasanton and list several options (if you want that, tell me your ZIP code and the type of injury; I can’t browse unless you ask me to perform a web search now).

Would you like me to draft a short call/email script or look up local lawyers for you? If so, tell me the ZIP and a bit about your case (type of injury, when it happened).
